info.title: API.SH: Envato Market
info.description: The Envato Market API from API.SH: public Envato Market data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A member's public profile on an Envato Market marketplace: username, avatar, member since, author rating and rating count, total sales, followers and following, badges, elite flag, freelance availability, bio (text and HTML), portfolio item counts per marketplace, featured item and public collections.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/envato-author

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Marketplace: `themeforest` (default), `codecanyon`, `videohive`, `audiojungle`, `graphicriver`, `photodune` or `3docean`. Ignored when `url` names the marketplace.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username or profile link, e.g. `axentmedia` or `https://codecanyon.net/user/axentmedia`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An author's items on one marketplace: id, title, link, price, category, stars, rating count, sales, thumbnail, preview image and details. Sort by newest, sales, rating, price or name. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/envato-author-items

parameters.description: Marketplace: `themeforest` (default), `codecanyon`, `videohive`, `audiojungle`, `graphicriver`, `photodune` or `3docean`. Ignored when `url` names the marketplace.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username or profile link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), sales, rating, price or name.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: asc or desc (default depends on sort).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-200). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/envato-best-sellers

parameters.name: site

get.description:
The public discussion on an Envato Market item: threads with the first comment and the replies, each with username, label (Purchased, Author, ...), whether it is the item's author, age and text. Search the comments with `term`, keep only buyers' and the author's comments, sort newest or oldest. 20 threads per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/envato-item-comments

parameters.description: An item link, or pass `id` and `site`.

get.description:
Buyer reviews of an Envato Market item: star rating, the reason given (design quality, customer support, code quality, ...), reviewer username, age, text and the author's response. 20 per page; sort by newest, highest or lowest rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/envato-item-reviews

get.description:
Items on an Envato Market marketplace (ThemeForest, CodeCanyon, VideoHive, AudioJungle, GraphicRiver, PhotoDune, 3DOcean) for keywords or a category, with every filter of the search page: sort, date added, sales level, minimum rating, price range, software version, compatible-with, tags and on-sale. Each item: id, title, link, price, author, category, rating and review count, sales, last update, attributes (software version, etc.), included file types, preview image, and for audio and video items the preview file, waveform, length and BPM. Also the total, the applied filters and the facets (each filter group with its options and counts; pass an option's `param`=`value` to filter). 30 items per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/envato-search

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Marketplace: `themeforest` (default), `codecanyon`, `videohive`, `audiojungle`, `graphicriver`, `photodune` or `3docean`. Ignored when `url` names the marketplace.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `wordpress` or `logo reveal`. Required unless `category` is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path, e.g. `wordpress/blog-magazine` (see /envato/v1/categories); with `term` it narrows the search.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), sales, rating, price-asc, price-desc, date (newest), updated or trending.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Added in the last day, week, month or year.

parameters.name: sales
parameters.description: Sales level: rank-0 (no sales) to rank-4 (top sellers).

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum star rating (1-4).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in whole US dollars.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price in whole US dollars.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Software version, e.g. `WordPress 6.x` or `PHP 8.x` (values in the `Software Version` facet).

parameters.name: compatible_with
parameters.description: Compatible with, e.g. `Elementor` or `WooCommerce` (values in the `Compatible With` facet).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A tag, e.g. `responsive`.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: true: only discounted items.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-60). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
